import { MathRandomType } from './types';
 
function guidString(hyphonate: boolean): string {
    const guidBlock = (Math.random().toString(16) + '000000000').substr(2, 8);
    return hyphonate ? '-' + guidBlock.substr(0, 4) + '-' + guidBlock.substr(4, 4) : guidBlock;
}
 
export function generateGuid(): string {
    return guidString(false) + guidString(true) + guidString(true) + guidString(false);
}
 
export function getGreatestCommonDivider(numberOne: number, numberTwo: number): number {
    return (numberTwo === 0) ? numberOne : getGreatestCommonDivider(numberTwo, numberOne % numberTwo);
}
 
/**
 * @description Returns modulo value for the given parameters. "%" in JavaScript is a remainder operator. For more information see: https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/JavaScript/Reference/Operators/Remainder
 * @param n Dividend
 * @param m Divisor (modulus)
 * @returns the modulo value
 */
Math.mod = function (n: number, m: number) {
    return ((n % m) + m) % m;
};
 
// eslint-disable-next-line  @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
Math.sortAscending = function (a: any, b: any): number {
    return a - b;
};
 
// eslint-disable-next-line  @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
Math.sortDescending = function (a: any, b: any): number {
    return b - a;
};
 
Math.getRandomRange = function (min: number, max: number, IasInt: boolean = false, Irng: MathRandomType = Math.random) {
    Iif (asInt) {
        min = Math.floor(min);
        max = Math.floor(max) + 1;
    }
    const rand = rng() * (max - min);
    return (asInt ? Math.floor(rand) : rand) + min;
};
 
Math.clamp = function (value: number, min: number = 0, max: number = 1) {
    return Math.min(Math.max(value, min), max);
};
 
Math.remapClamp = function (value: number, low: number, high: number, remapLow: number = 0, remapHigh: number = 1) {
    return value.remap(low, high, remapLow, remapHigh).clamp(remapLow, remapHigh);
};
 
Math.remap = function (value: number, low: number, high: number, remapLow: number = 0, remapHigh: number = 1): number {
    return remapLow + (value - low) * (remapHigh - remapLow) / (high - low);
};
 
Math.smoothStep = function (value: number, clamp: boolean = true) {
    const t = clamp ? value.clamp(0, 1) : value;
    return Math.pow(t, 2) * (3 - 2 * t);
};
 
Math.smootherStep = function (value: number, clamp: boolean = true) {
    const t = clamp ? value.clamp(0, 1) : value;
    return Math.pow(t, 3) * (t * (t * 6 - 15) + 10);
};
 
Math.roundToNearestMultiple = function (value: number, multiple: number) {
    const resto = value.mod(multiple);
    Iif (resto <= (multiple / 2)) {
        return value - resto;
    } else {
        return value + multiple - resto;
    }
};
 
Math.interpolate = function (value: number, target: number, t: number): number {
    return value + (target - value) * t;
};
 
Math.interpolateDelta = function (value: number, target: number, t: number, dt: number): number {
    return value.interpolate(target, 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, dt));
};
